P1.heading: 6.1  Pillar 1: Strategy, Governance & Culture

P2.findings_md:
Overall P2 Score: 2.558 | Peer Median: 3.47 | Gap: −0.91 | Largest Pillar by Weight (30%)

P2.heading: 6.2  Pillar 2: Member Experience & Products

P3.findings_md:

P3.heading: 6.3  Pillar 3: Operations, Risk & Compliance

P4.findings_md:
Overall P4 Score: 2.027 | Peer Median: 3.17 | Gap: −1.14

(Data, 1.73) and (AI, 1.73) are the two weakest categories across the entire four-pillar assessment. (Integration, 2.06) fires two connected caps. PATTERN-2 (AI Infrastructure Gap) and PATTERN-3 (Four-Merger Integration Deficit) define P4.
